player: An inspection earns its turn when the answer changes a later choice enough to repay the time spent obtaining it.
The mechanism accepts a press during a limited interval. A slower setting widens that opportunity while reducing the output of a successful run.
small-world: Only Advance beat moves the cycle forward. Selecting a worker, walking or inspecting state does not consume a beat.
The identifier belongs to an attempt, not an action type. A new move needs a new ID; repeating an ID asks for the existing outcome.
commit-window: Discarding unfinished output does not release the operator’s reservation. That claim still needs an explicit disposition.
custody-room: This is the event that last informed the selected observer. It may be older than the event now shown in the room.
hearing-room: The doorway condition matters only across rooms. In the near position, both people stand on the same side.
work-benches: The model combines notes automatically. It does not check whether their claims agree or whether the resulting brief is good.
handoff-table: A group of related running processes. This validator needed its identifier before it would permit execution.
delegation-parnas: What another part can ask for and rely on receiving, even if the storage behind the door changes.
delegation-automation: The exception and recovery still belong to someone after the routine cycle has been automated.
delegation-agency: The courier may change its route here. It cannot change the destination or the commission.
delegation-initiative: No confidence score is calculated here. The two prompts supply different amounts of information.
grip-boundary: The outlined space the torso occupies in this invented drawing. It exposes a relation that an isolated wrist point omits.
inspection-rig: The tested unit is the worker’s actual session: its permissions, display and recording path. Installing the same tool on the host does not transfer those conditions.
sampling-desk: The load is fully concealed from 1.1 to 2.0 seconds in this drawing. A three-second cadence can miss that interval; shifting the sample times changes what enters the review.
memory-desk: Two places are an authored attention limit, not a measured memory capacity. The reply can remain safely stored and still be absent from the decision.
field-note: The second look establishes closed at 10:00. It does not reveal when the door closed during the intervening hour.
composition-stage: Size, contrast and placement compete for attention. Increasing one element’s prominence can make a neighboring action harder to read.
frame-allocation: The crop stays centered at a fixed image scale. Reserving the rail keeps the picture window’s height constant; it does not shrink the scene to fit new words.
contact-stage: The hand briefly moves away from the control before reaching it. That preparation is shared by both versions; the comparison changes how the rest of the body participates.
release-score: While contact is maintained, Sam’s hand follows Bob’s shoulder. After withdrawal, the hand no longer inherits Bob’s movement. This drawing models that target relationship, not a force that physically supports him.
search-yard: The centre of a route is not the whole vehicle. The check expands obstacles by the cargo footprint before testing the path between waypoints.
candidate-archive: The archive keeps route definitions, not just their old scores. The same A, B and E geometry is checked again under the changed requirement.
story-workshop: A condition can make a scene available without forcing it to happen. Selection still determines which available scene enters this history.
sentence-bench: Wording can require a fact or commitment that the scene has not established. A character may be mistaken or unreliable, but that must be an intended part of the scene.
inspection-bench: The connection that translates a control action into a call to the rule. Calling the rule directly leaves that connection untested.
judge-desk: The base rate is missing-crate deliveries divided by all deliveries: 1/20 or 5/20 here. It differs from the share of missing crates the judge catches.
coverage-floor: The stamps retain which rooms were visited. They discard the order of those visits and who still owns unfinished work.
flight-tunnel: Both pilots use the same body size and fixed paths. Neither steers in response to the gate, so admitting both does not establish how a player who reacts, hesitates or changes course would fare.
stall-map: Zero on the ruler is the beginning of measured time, after a 30-second warm-up. It is not the instant the page opened.
resource-ledger: Previously supplied input read from a prompt cache is a separate accounting category. Its token count is not interchangeable with newly supplied input or generated output for pricing.
release-manifest: Keep the exact source version and exclusion record together. A later adopter needs to know which proposed change is absent from the selected runtime.
commission-desk: Assign who evaluates the stopping evidence and what returns after a stop: the result, current build and disposition. A threshold without a receiver can leave work suspended.
